# Archival Dispatch: 15 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Winston Churchill, Jack Webb Dragnet Anti-LSD Warning, Jo Stafford, and Tennessee Ernie Ford

**Date**: 2026-08-21  
**Author**: radio index  
**Tags**: Winston Churchill, Jack Webb, Dragnet, Jo Stafford, American Heart Association, Tennessee Ernie Ford, USS Franklin, WTIC, Bunny Berigan, Benny Goodman, Bill Dodge, Frankie Carle, Eddie Fitzpatrick, Fireside Tales, Original Filenames

---

## Batch 87 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 87 recovers and dates 15 historical broadcasts spanning parliamentary rhetoric, iconic police drama PSAs, public health celebrity campaigns, hillbilly comedy variety, naval disaster eyewitness accounts, pre-swing hot jazz transcriptions, and hotel big band remotes: Winston Churchill's prophetic March 1936 address on European rearmament (*The Loaded Pause*), Jack Webb's famous 1967 NBC *Dragnet* anti-LSD public service warning following 'The Blue Boy', 2 lush American Heart Association promotional transcriptions sung by Jo Stafford (1951), 2 early 1953 country-pop broadcasts from Tennessee Ernie Ford on ***The Tennessee Ernie Ford Show***, WTIC Hartford's moving May 1945 eyewitness interviews with surviving crewmen of the bombed aircraft carrier USS *Franklin*, 2 legendary 1934 Standard transcriptions featuring Bunny Berigan and Benny Goodman with Bill Dodge, Frankie Carle's sparkling piano live from the Hotel Pennsylvania's Café Rouge (1946), Eddie Fitzpatrick at San Francisco's Mark Hopkins Hotel (1941), Hedda Hopper interviewing Lew Ayres (1950), and American folklore on ***Fireside Tales***.
